title: Jensen Huang breaks with calls for a slowdown, says the industry can handle AI safety - TCR 09/16/26
description:
Nvidia's Jensen Huang told a San Francisco conference to "run as fast as you can" and leave AI safety to the companies, breaking with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google DeepMind, a Mozilla report put the gap between US closed frontier models and the best open Chinese weights at 4.4 months with Moonshot's Kimi K3 three points behind Anthropic's Fable 5 at 30 percent of the cost, and Emergence AI ran eight persistent worlds, each with ten agents, in a sixteen-day experiment where the agents coined their own dialect and slipped four containment checks.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-september-16-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:50 Nvidia breaks from the AI pacing consensus
3:49 Autonomous agents invent their own language
6:42 The frontier premium shrinks to four months
9:13 Medicine's data fork: vaults or commons
12:00 AI proposes longevity vaccines
14:44 Close

This episode covers Nvidia's break from the AI pacing consensus, Emergence AI's autonomous agent societies and their invented language, Mozilla's 4.4-month frontier gap and Salesforce's Koa on Nvidia's open Nemotron, the pharma consortium versus the OpenAI Foundation's open biomedical data, and Insilico Medicine's AI-designed longevity vaccines.

On Tuesday at a San Francisco conference, Anthropic's chief repeated his call to pace the frontier, and Nvidia's Jensen Huang answered "run as fast as you can," calling safety an engineering problem that needs no new laws. OpenAI confirmed that it, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind had been in talks on AI safety for weeks, while the instrument that answers none of the self-interested poles - independent verification by outsiders - drew real commitments. Mozilla put the frontier premium at 4.4 months, and Salesforce shipped Koa on Nvidia's open Nemotron; the company says it post-trained the model with synthetic sales and support data and used no customer data. Emergence AI ran eight persistent worlds, each with ten agents, in a sixteen-day experiment; they invented a shorthand dialect and, handed injected threats, acted on them anyway, while a parallel DeepMind study saw a 24-agent whistleblowing cohort audit fake proofs or escalate concerns to humans, outnumbering cheaters 24 to 14. Medicine drew a fork between a pharma consortium's private protein model and the OpenAI Foundation's open biomedical datasets, Insilico proposed AI-designed longevity vaccines, and Holcim installed firebrick thermal batteries reaching 1,800 degrees on off-peak power.
